answers: Primary Zone: Node 12 (HUMAN\_GNLY > 1,220, HUMAN\_GZMB < = 1. 419, HUM ANCST3 < 0. 784, HUM A NST3 < = 0.598)Mechanistic Rationale: CD45+ cell types are associated with immune responses. It is established that the presence of cytotoxic lymphocytes such as natural killer (NK) cells and cytotoxi T lymphoctyes (CTLs) are important mediators of anti-tumor immune responses . Natural killer (Nk) cells are innate immune cells involved in the recognition and elimination of transformed and virus infected cells through cytolytic activity and secretion of inflammatory cytokines . Cytotoxic T lympohcytes (CTLs), on the other hand, are critical players in tumor surveillance, recognizing cancer cells via their major histocompatibility complex (MHC) I molecules and eliminating them via cytolysis and release of granzyme B. In addition, CTLs can induce apoptosis and senescence of cancer cells independent of direct contact through Fas ligand binding to FAS receptor. Both NK cells and CTLs have been found to express glycolipid CD45R0 antigen , indicating that they may be responsible for the positive association between HUM AN_GNLY, HUM_GZ MB and HUM_ANCS3. CD45RO is also known as a marker for memory T cells, which persist long term in the body, allowing for rapid and robust recall responses upon subsequent encounter with their cognate antigens. This observation suggests that a robust adaptive immune response could be required for positive regulation of CD4 5RA. LITERATURE-CONFRIMED FINDINGs: * CD45 + cells have been shown to be associated with immune response in various diseases. For example, increased levels of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells are associated with improved survival rates in ovarian cancer patients treated with chemotherapy . In addition, elevated numbers of total CD45 RO + memory T cells were observed in the cerebrospinal fluid of patients with neurocysticercosis compared to controls . Furthermore, in patients with hepatitis C virus infection, circulating CD45 R0 + cells are more abundant in those who responded well to treatment compared to those who did not respond . NEW TESTABLE MECHANISMS: * Although CD45 is expressed at different levels depending on the cell type, further investigation should be conducted on whether CD45 plays a role in regulating CD45 expression.

Primary Zone: Node 11
MECHANISMATIC RATIONALE: This zone suggests that there exists a positive association between the presence of CD4+ naïve T cells and the presence of CCR7+ CD4+ T cells. Additionally, the presence of LAG3+ CD4+-activated memory T cells indicates increased likelihood of having CCR7-CD4+ T cell. Furthermore, the presence CCL19 chemokine also increases the likelihood of CCR-CD4 T cells. These relationships align with our understanding of T cell biology. For instance, CD4+CD45RO+CCR7-T cells have been shown to increase during active EBV infection , indicating a role for this subset in EBV clearance. Further, studies have demonstrated that the differentiation of activated memory CD4+T cells into effector T cells requires the acquisition of the transcription factor PLZF . In particular, PLZF can regulate the expression of genes encoding cytolytic proteins such as perforin and granzyme A and B , and is required for efficient production of IFNγ by Th1 cells , which play an important role in the immune response against viruses. Also, CCL18 is produced by dendritic cells upon activation and is involved in recruiting mature CD4+ and CD8+ T cells to sites of inflammation . Finally, CCR7 mediates migration of DCs towards lymphoid tissue expressing CCL1. Thus, CCR19 expression on DCs could promote their accumulation at sites where the virus resides. Additionally, it could facilitate antigen presentation to CD4+ helper T cells that migrate towards these same areas through their interaction with CCR7. In summary, this zone suggests that the presence of the three markers in question is indicative of an active anti-viral immune response against EBV.
